dict.Nu găsesc tabelul cu operațiuni: trebuie: Cannot find the transactions table: there must be a header row with Date and Amount (or Debit and Credit).
dict.Plățile sunt cu minus. Schimbi categoria: Payments are negative. Change the category of a transaction on the Statement sheet (column F) and the summary updates by itself.
dict.Tabelul nu are nicio operațiune cu dată: The table has no transaction with a date and an amount.
dict.Extrasul de cont (fișierul .csv descărca: The bank statement (the .csv file downloaded from the bank) as a table: date, description, income, payments, balance, category and a monthly summary
dict.Extrasul de cont (fișierul .csv, .xlsx s: The bank statement (the .csv, .xlsx or .xls file downloaded from the bank) as a table: date, description, income, payments, balance, category and a monthly summary
The bank statement (the .pdf, .csv, .xlsx or .xls file downloaded from the bank) as a table: date, description, income, payments, balance, category and a monthly summary
dict.PDF-ul nu are text (e scanat, doar poze): The PDF has no text (it is scanned, images only). First run text recognition (OCR) on it in the PDF module, save it and try again.
dict.Adaugă, schimbă sau șterge rânduri, apoi: Add, change or delete rows, then File → Apply category rules: the categories and the Summary are rebuilt, and the rules are remembered for the next statements.
dict.Fiecare rând: un cuvânt (sau o bucată de: Each row: a word (or part of a word) from the description and its category. Upper / lower case and diacritics do not matter.
dict.Prima regulă care se potrivește câștigă:: The first matching rule wins: put the more specific rules higher. Words of up to 4 letters are matched only as whole words.
dict.Foaia Reguli nu are niciun rând cu cuvân: The Rules sheet has no row with a word and a category.
dict.Refă categoriile din foaia Extras după r: Rebuild the categories on the Statement sheet from the rules on the Rules sheet (and the Summary); categories changed by hand are replaced. The rules are remembered for the next statements
dict.Fără comisioane, numerar și plăți cu car: Without fees, cash and card payments (transactions without a partner). You can also sort or filter by partner on the Statement sheet (column B).
dict.Fiecare rând: un cuvânt (sau o bucată de: Each row: a word (or part of a word) from the partner name or the description, and its category. Upper / lower case and diacritics do not matter.
dict.Plățile sunt cu minus. Schimbi categoria: Payments are negative. Change the category of a transaction on the Statement sheet (column G) and the summary updates by itself.
